desc:
⚽ Start at 8. Chase the Ballon d'Or. Build your football legacy in Futball Life, a career simulator where your choices shape your rise.

Begin in a youth academy at age 8 or sign your first senior contract at 16. Pick your country and position, choose your club, and turn potential into a career worth remembering.

📈 Develop your player, earn the manager's trust, and fight for a starting spot.
✍️ Negotiate contracts, attract transfer offers, and chase your dream move.
🏆 Hunt league titles, domestic cups, European glory, and the Ballon d'Or.
🌍 Earn a national team call-up and represent your country.
📱 Handle teammate messages, dressing room rivalries, and big career decisions.
💪 Overcome injuries, build relationships, and chase the captain's armband.
🧠 Set your tactics and make key half-time decisions as matches simulate.
⏩ Follow every matchday or fly through seasons in Fast mode.

Will you become the next football legend?

⭐ Like and favorite Futball Life. Your career starts here
